issues.description: The specification/UML declares Animal.name as type String, but the provided solution declares the backing field as StringBuilder. This type mismatch between the problem statement and the solution can confuse students about the expected attribute type and how to implement the getter/setter (the UML and textual description expect a String field).
issues.suggestedFix: Align the solution with the specification by changing the Animal.name field to type String (private String name), and update the constructor, getName(), and setName() to use String directly instead of StringBuilder. This preserves the intended UML design and avoids confusing students about the expected attribute type.
